article_title: 'What you see is what you pay' - why some US restaurants are banning tips

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly examining?
options: Why some US restaurants replace tipping with transparent prices and fixed wages, and why the model remains difficult
Why American restaurants are refusing to employ kitchen staff
How diners can calculate the largest possible gratuity
Why every US state has legally prohibited tips
tasks.correct_answer: Why some US restaurants replace tipping with transparent prices and fixed wages, and why the model remains difficult
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת מדוע חלק מהמסעדות בארה״ב עוברות למחירים הכוללים את עלות השירות ולשכר קבוע, וכן את הקשיים שמונעים מהמודל להתפשט במהירות.

tasks.prompt: What does the $140 price at La Cigale include?
options: Only the food, with tax and tips added later
A meal plus a voluntary 25% gratuity
The meal, tax and service, with no tip or extra fee
A yearly membership for regular customers
tasks.correct_answer: The meal, tax and service, with no tip or extra fee
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ב־La Cigale המחיר הקבוע של 140 דולר כולל את הארוחה, המס והוצאות השירות; אין שורת טיפ או עמלה נוספת.

tasks.prompt: What benefit does wine waiter Caroline Kraetzer receive from La Cigale's model?
options: She keeps every tip given to the kitchen
She chooses a different wage after every table
She pays no tax on restaurant income
She earns about $40 an hour without relying on customers' tips
tasks.correct_answer: She earns about $40 an hour without relying on customers' tips
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המלצרית המתמחה ביין קרוליין קרצר מרוויחה כ־40 דולר לשעה ואינה תלויה בנדיבות משתנה של לקוחות.

tasks.prompt: Why can a tip-free menu look more expensive than a comparable traditional menu?
options: The restaurant must import every ingredient
Customers see labour, tax or service costs in the listed price instead of adding them later
Tip-free restaurants are required to serve twice as much food
Restaurants hide the price until the customer leaves
tasks.correct_answer: Customers see labour, tax or service costs in the listed price instead of adding them later
tasks.explanation_hebrew: במודל ללא טיפ העלות המלאה גלויה כבר במחיר התפריט, בעוד שבמסעדה רגילה מס וטיפ מתווספים בהמשך ולכן מחיר הבסיס נראה נמוך יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does “equitably” mean when owners say they want to pay staff more equitably?
options: Secretly and without records
Only when the restaurant is full
In a fair way that considers different workers
According to the size of each customer's tip
tasks.correct_answer: In a fair way that considers different workers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: equitably פירושו באופן הוגן ושוויוני יותר, למשל לצמצם את הפער בין צוות השירות לבין עובדי המטבח.

tasks.prompt: If the disadvantages “outweigh” the advantages of removing tips, what does that mean?
options: The disadvantages are more important or greater
The disadvantages can be measured in kilograms
The advantages have been completely misunderstood
The two sides are exactly equal
tasks.correct_answer: The disadvantages are more important or greater
tasks.explanation_hebrew: outweigh פירושו להיות משמעותי או כבד יותר. כאן הכוונה שהחסרונות עשויים להיות גדולים מן היתרונות.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons supporters prefer a no-tip restaurant model.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני יתרונות שונים המופיעים בכתבה ולחבר כל יתרון לעובדים או לסועדים.
expected_points: Workers can receive more stable income
Staff do not depend on the generosity or bias of strangers
Kitchen and front-of-house workers can be paid more fairly
Customers know the full amount they will pay
The model can reduce pressure or uncertainty around tipping

tasks.prompt: Why may some restaurants struggle to sustain a tip-free system?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שני לחצים כלכליים או התנהגותיים המקשים על המודל.
expected_points: Menu prices must rise to cover higher fixed wages
Customers may compare the higher visible price with menus that exclude tips
Higher recorded revenue can create additional tax costs
Some experienced servers may prefer the earning potential of tips
Restaurants may struggle to retain staff or maintain profits
Removing tips may reduce a familiar motivation for service

tasks.prompt: Summarise the main arguments for and against banning tips in US restaurants.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום מאוזן באנגלית הכולל לפחות יתרון אחד, קושי אחד ודוגמה מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Supporters argue that fixed wages offer stability and fairness
Transparent all-inclusive prices let diners know the final cost
La Cigale charges a fixed $140 and pays staff without tips
Critics worry about higher menu prices and financial sustainability
Some servers may prefer tips because they can increase earnings
The article suggests tipping is unlikely to disappear quickly

tasks.prompt: Write a short recommendation to a restaurant considering a no-tip policy. Use two lessons from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג המלצה מעשית באנגלית ולבסס אותה על שני לקחים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Explain clearly that prices include service, tax or labour costs
Set wages that provide staff with stability
Consider fair pay for kitchen and front-of-house workers
Compare the total customer bill, not only menu prices
Plan for payroll, revenue and tax effects
Ask workers and customers for feedback before making the change
